title: Bounded constructible complexes form a triangulated subcategory for the finiteness coefficients
statement: Let $\ell$ be a prime and $\Lambda$ one of the coefficient rings of Deligne's finiteness theorems: the continuous-function condensed rings [def-sfb-continuous-map-condensed-ring] of $\mathcal O_E$ or $E$ for a finite extension $E$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, the condensed ring $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ [sk-def-sfb-qlbar-condensed], or a finite ring of $\ell$-power order. Let $X$ be a scheme whose underlying topological space is noetherian and $\Lambda_X$ the pulled-back coefficient ring [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients]. Then the bounded constructible complexes of $\Lambda_X$-modules [def-sfb-bounded-constructible-complexes], those $K$ with $H^i(K)=0$ for all but finitely many $i$ and every $H^i(K)$ constructible [def-sfb-constructible-module], form a triangulated subcategory [def-weil-triangulated-subcategory] of $D(\Mod_{\Lambda_X})$.

proof.text: Constructible zero objects use the identity one-stratum stratification and the rank-zero cokernel presentation. Constructibility is invariant under isomorphism. Package closure of canonical kernels and cokernels as closure under arbitrary limiting cones, using their unique isomorphisms to the canonical objects.

For finite normed ℓ-adic fields, lift the coefficient type to the scheme universe, use the proved lfp local-freeness theorem, and transport along liftCoefficientIso and comap equivalences. Apply the existing locally-free constructible Serre argument. For the algebraic closure apply its existing Serre theorem.

For integral coefficients use the induced normed-field structure from the embedding, prove its normed ℚ_ℓ-algebra inequality, and apply integralConstructible_serre. For a supplied closed unit ball identify its subring with continuousIntegers by the norm membership equivalence and apply the same result.
For finite discrete ℓ-power-torsion coefficients use the finite discrete internal kernel theorem and the generic constructible cokernel and extension theorem.

For each constructor of IsFinitenessCoefficient these results make constructibility a weak Serre object property containing zero. The existing generic DerivedCategory.homologyProperty criterion makes constructible cohomology triangulated. Intersect it with the bounded property of the canonical t-structure, also triangulated. This intersection is definitionally the original boundedConstructible predicate.
